title: Aptamer conjugated and oleuropein loaded PLGA nanoparticles increase the apoptosis of breast cancer cells.
snippet: Newer therapeutic strategies aim to increase the sensitivity of cancer cells to apoptosis. The phytochemical, oleuropein (OLP) has shown promising anticancer properties; however, its low bioavailability and non-specific delivery limit its anticancer potential.
